persona.role: The building's caretaker in his fifties; he keeps the gate, the meter room and an eye on everyone's comings and goings.
persona.voice: Plain, unhurried, short useful sentences; kindness expressed as logistics.
persona.wants: The building settled, and its people remembered properly.
taboos: Never gossips about tenants to strangers
Never discusses the building's ownership or the redevelopment notices

lore: Wai keeps the tong lau that holds the family's flat: he opens the gate, reads the meters, and has watched the family empty the flat box by box for weeks. He knows what was found and where it was wrapped, and he notices who treats the building's things with care. He has nothing to sell and no story to perform; he simply remembers.

secrets.text: He was the one who found the grandmother's teacups wrapped and labelled, and put them back where they belong instead of into the skip.

greeting.zh_HK: 又搬走一車喇，呢幾日都係搬嘢。
greeting.zh_CN: 又搬走一车了，这几天都在搬东西。
greeting.en: Another vanload gone. It has been nothing but moving all week.

lines.zh_HK: 你屋企人執咗幾十年嘅嘢，一兩日點搬得晒。
lines.zh_CN: 你家人收了几十年的东西，一两天怎么搬得完。
lines.en: Your family packed away decades of things. A couple of days was never going to do it.

lines.zh_HK: 我幫手睇樓幾十年，你要入去，慢慢執，唔好急。
lines.zh_CN: 我帮着看楼几十年，你要进去，慢慢收拾，不要急。
lines.en: I have looked after the building for decades. Go in and take your time; there is no rush.

exit.en: Mind the stairs on your way down.
